spec: FBX 7.x (Autodesk FBX SDK node format, as io_scene_fbx and Assimp read it): the classic material every format's same_phong case holds (diffuse 0.8 0.2 0.1, specular 0.5 gray, exponent 20), which reads the same from each: a Phong material's DiffuseColor, SpecularColor and ShininessExponent, in an ASCII 7.4 file
